items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I made some records with him.

ctx.x: I made some records with him. Yeah, yeah. But I just, just gigs we called. Yeah. No, I never played. All the work, most I played out here with, was between Mutt and Ory. Well, practically Ory. At the time, I was working with this band in the war with Winslow Allen. Over the place they call it Strip City now. Peacorn Western. We were working at nightclub. That's why I got drafted in Army again.

I was going to ask a little bit about Mutt, since Mutt, Kerry, isn't here anymore. He did a talk for himself. In the first place, I was wondering about how old Mutt was. Do you think he was as old as Ory? Ory thought he was about the same age, maybe.

Well, I don't know. From my cousin, she told me Mutt is not as old as Ory. Wasn't as old. No, they may be about a year, two years different than the age. But he said he wasn't, but there's a big argument going on now about how old Ory is.
